Reduce exaggerated oversized round eyes and rounded toddler-like faces to the natural early reference. Heads and shoulders should have the original early proportions. The main visual change must be the faces and a significantly calmer lighting balance. Reduce excessive yellow/orange lamp glow and oversaturated orange hair, reveal neutral gray STONE, dark wood, natural skin and cream fabric, retain blue-green lake light. Lamps glow locally, the whole room does not become orange. Keep all identities, eye colors, their current fully closed clothes, relative heights and small supported cloth toys. Robin keeps his BROWN tuft, GREEN eyes, SAND sweater, TERRACOTTA trousers, cream golden-snitch socks, proper small toy scale and unique location. Cot and floating pram are EMPTY while Robin is held. Keep EXACT original eight panel arrangement and ALL original texts including 'Sábado por la mañana.', all dialogue and final question '¿Lista, Granger?'. Keep the upper-left header 'Capítulo 9 · 15'.
